exceptions.rationale: The digest guard remains defense in depth after strict lane-result parsing has already produced a bounded JSON-only value.
exceptions.invariant: canonicalLanePayloadDigest receives only the recursively parsed and persistence-safe result returned by parseLaneResult.

exceptions.rationale: The overflow guard documents the numeric boundary even though a finite monotonic clock plus a valid Date delta cannot overflow.
exceptions.invariant: Both operands are finite and the bounded Date-domain delta cannot move a finite IEEE-754 monotonic value to infinity.

exceptions.rationale: A read failure after a directory entry was confirmed as a regular file requires an operating-system race or permission transition that is not portable to reproduce.
exceptions.invariant: Normal malformed, oversized, and ownership-conflicting diagnostic files are covered; this catch preserves fail-closed behavior for post-enumeration I/O failure.

exceptions.rationale: The coordinator retains a final receipt-shape assertion after the durable journal has already validated the committed response.
exceptions.invariant: runDurableTransaction returns only a committed response bound to the prepared transaction and validated ReviewRecord payload.

exceptions.rationale: The second receipt parser is a local defense after persistence has already accepted the exact typed committed response.
exceptions.invariant: Persistence validates the response as the transaction-bound ReviewRecord before returning it to the coordinator validator.

exceptions.rationale: Conflicting START responses are rejected by journal input and committed-response identity checks before this local assertion.
exceptions.invariant: A START idempotency key can return only its immutable committed response or fail persistence identity validation earlier.

exceptions.rationale: The RESULT response equality assertion remains defensive after the journal binds the response to the exact prepared proposal.
exceptions.invariant: The committed proposal response is canonicalized and identity-checked against the prepared effect before coordinator return.

exceptions.rationale: The terminal-to-active guard remains beside effect construction although every public transition rejects FINALIZED input first.
exceptions.invariant: No validated resume, activation, reconciliation, or finalization transition can request an active status from FINALIZED.

exceptions.rationale: Accepted terminal lanes are derived from the same persisted proposal pairs immediately before durable effects are assembled.
exceptions.invariant: A lane enters the accepted set only when reconciliation has already matched its exact persisted proposal identity.

exceptions.rationale: Accepted terminal lanes are derived only from complete proposal and PostToolUse publication pairs in the frozen snapshot.
exceptions.invariant: A lane enters the accepted set only after its proposal key has matched one exact persisted PostToolUse publication.

exceptions.rationale: The trusted transaction factory assigns the captured consumption result before returning every non-transaction recovery plan.
exceptions.invariant: The wrapper returns either a recovered transaction response or the factory-captured result; no third successful state exists.

exceptions.rationale: The persistence recovery scan reads and validates the same START receipt before this adapter-level defensive reread occurs.
exceptions.invariant: Unreadable START receipt state fails in recoverPendingReviewTransactions before committedStartResponse can reread it.

exceptions.rationale: Malformed START receipts are rejected by the authoritative persistence recovery validator before this local shape assertion.
exceptions.invariant: Only a persistence-validated receipt can survive the recovery scan and reach committedStartResponse for projection.

exceptions.rationale: A read failure after an equivalent-state entry was confirmed as a regular file requires a non-portable operating-system race or permission transition.
exceptions.invariant: Unavailable directories, excessive entries, malformed paths, oversized files, and invalid JSON are covered before this post-enumeration I/O fallback.

exceptions.rationale: The adapter retains a scope assertion although every public START activation freezes scope before creating its durable receipt.
exceptions.invariant: A committed START response can reach replay only after transaction validation of the scope-bound review produced by review_start.

exceptions.rationale: The strict native tracker parser rejects empty and over-limit paths before lane ownership validation receives the tracker.
exceptions.invariant: validateLaneStart uses only parseNativeTracker output whose tracker_path has already passed the same bounded-string limits.

exceptions.rationale: Strict diagnostic parsing requires exactly one tool-name or program provenance form before provenance matching begins.
exceptions.invariant: Every validated DiagnosticSubmission has either tool_name or program, so the exhaustive matcher cannot reach its final fallback.
